title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Dylan Kuhn Geo…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Dylan Kuhn Geo Mashup through version 1.13.23. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 7.1, indicating high severity with impacts on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No explicit patch or remediation information is provided.
